name: content-lifecycle-ext
description: Core refinements of the harness's generic content lifecycle: quality control across a folio's QA checks (placement PR1, #1702), reviewer comments on a folio's edit-set (moved down from cat-harness, bean lthi), the content block change summary for a delivery (split from delivery-summary, placement PR2, bean pzwb), and the contracts two lower roles are held to in this layer's diagrams: the corpus when an accepted edit is committed, and an external registry when a source's authority is checked.
